AWS signed a definitive agreement to acquire DuckLabs (Amsterdam), the company behind open-source analytical database DuckDB; deal terms/price undisclosed by either side. DuckDB co-founders Hannes Muhleisen and Mark Raasveldt join AWS and continue leading the open-source project's direction; DuckDB itself remains free/open-source (MIT license) under the independent DuckDB Foundation, not acquired. DuckLabs expected to join AWS in early September 2026.
